text: To Steenbarger's hold: the one trigger I ratify is close_above:high_52w_close on D, a daily close at a new 52-week closing high, ACT_NOW. reclaim:ma_20 waits for a pullback under the 20-day average and buys it, a buy on the reaction (C5); I hold that objection. HOG is D HH/HL, 1.22% under the 20-day high, 9>21 on all frames: at its high, so the entry is the new high (C5, C16). day_vol 1.39 is not my test (R5). No second group name, so this is no group call (C14). Wrong if a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high prints (C7, my translation).
